purpose: Opt-in disposable Windows VM regression harness; never run input fixtures on a working desktop
staging: Copy the selected guest scripts to the disposable guest user Downloads directory
installedRuntime: Use the installed Personal Computer Use resources/python-runtime/python.exe

tests.interactions: guest-interactions.py uses a loopback simulated VLM and the real installed app, screenshots, WinForms fixture and input stack
tests.liveVision: guest-live-vision.py requires signed-in Codex and test_codex_live.py staged in Downloads
tests.lifecycle: guest-lifecycle.py requires no other app instance; checks authentication, single instance, crash restart and clean quit
tests.unit: guest-unit-tests.py discovers extracted unit tests and imports installed modules
tests.javascript: guest-js.ps1 extracts production modules from installed app.asar and runs suites using bundled Electron Node mode
tests.liveDesktop: guest-live-desktop.py requires an already running installed app, signed-in Codex, a native focus check and real Approve click; --gated-only repeats approval case

privacy: No credentials belong in these scripts or installer. VM-only login caches must be removed with clone cleanup.
